verdict.rationale: GST is a national tax regime run through a government portal. Self-hosting the core product is a category error for that kind of service, because no user could deploy their own instance of the government tax system. The GST Offline Tool only prepares invoices locally for upload to the official portal, so it does not show that the core product can be self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
